##### Project general facts

Sun Island Villas, the distinguished offering of Ajmal Makan, delivers a curated collection of four to seven‑bedroom waterfront residences within Sharjah Waterfront City. The development comprises three hundred twenty‑one exclusive villas, each crafted with contemporary amenities and forward‑looking technologies that integrate smart systems and artificial intelligence. Architectural intent blends striking aesthetics with intelligent design, ensuring each home maximises comfort, well‑being and future‑ready living.

Residents benefit from an array of upscale amenities that include vibrant shopping complexes, dynamic theme parks and expansive green‑space entertainment zones spread throughout the community. The smart‑home ecosystem features integrated sensors, wireless controls, home‑automation panels and a comprehensive intercom video system for seamless connectivity. Sustainable features such as a solar water‑heater system complement the lifestyle, underscoring the commitment to eco‑friendly living.

Interiors showcase premium marble surfaces, high‑quality porcelain tiles and branded kitchen fittings that elevate everyday living. Doors and windows of top‑grade specification enhance security and aesthetic appeal, while every bathroom offers the choice of a shower or a bathtub. The overall finishing embraces modern elegance through high‑quality materials, delivering a cohesive and refined interior palette. 

##### Location description and benefits

Al Hamriya enjoys a coveted position along the pristine Arabian Gulf coastline, offering residents immediate access to sparkling waters and panoramic sea views. The district is conveniently linked to Dubai International, Sharjah International and Ras Al Khaimah airports via Al Ittihad Road, Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Emirates Road. This network of major thoroughfares ensures swift connectivity to the broader Gulf region.

The neighbourhood lies within short reach of five key maritime gateways, including Hamriyah, Ajman, Umm Al Quwain, Ras Al Khaimah and the Port of Fujairah, facilitating both commercial and leisure travel. It forms part of an intricate archipelago of eight islands, interwoven by natural canals that showcase thirty‑six kilometres of coastal splendour. Tidal rhythms refresh the surrounding waters twice daily, enhancing the vibrant waterfront atmosphere.

A dominant portion of the surrounding environment is devoted to landscaped gardens, parks and verdant promenades that weave through the community. Flower beds, green plains and meticulously maintained roadways create a tranquil backdrop that can be admired from any angle. Internationally recognised green‑building standards guide development, reinforcing Al Hamriya’s reputation as an environmentally responsible and aesthetically pleasing destination.
